stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure5.gif##

figureAlts.figure5.gif: The image shows a table and a fill-in-the-blank code block related to simulating a test statistic under the null hypothesis. The table has columns Elevation and Specimen Length, with data: Row 1: High, 12.3; Row 2: Low, 13.1; Row 3: High, 12.0. Below the table, part (d) asks to fill in the blanks in the code. The code defines a function one_simulation. Inside, shuffled_labels is assigned a blank, shuffled_flies is assigned a blank, grouped is assigned a blank, means is set to grouped.column('Specimen length mean'), and statistic is assigned a blank.
